//! HTTP Basic authentication against the `users` table, mirroring
//! ShogunCoreAuthenticationProvider + BasicAuthenticationFilter.

use axum::http::HeaderMap;
use base64::Engine;
use deadpool_postgres::Pool;

use crate::db;
use crate::perms::Principal;

#[derive(Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum AuthError {
    /// 401 + WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="SHOGun Realm"
    Unauthorized,
}

/// Authenticate the request. Mirrors:
/// - no/malformed credentials -> 401
/// - unknown user -> 401 (UsernameNotFoundException)
/// - inactive user -> 401 (DisabledException)
/// - wrong password -> 401 (BadCredentialsException)
/// - user without any authority -> unauthenticated token -> effectively 401
pub async fn authenticate(pool: &Pool, headers: &HeaderMap) -> Result<Principal, AuthError> {
    let header = headers
        .get(axum::http::header::AUTHORIZATION)
        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
        .ok_or(AuthError::Unauthorized)?;
    let rest = match header.split_once(' ') {
        Some((scheme, cred)) if scheme.eq_ignore_ascii_case("basic") => cred.trim(),
        _ => return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized),
    };
    let decoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD
        .decode(rest)
        .map_err(|_| AuthError::Unauthorized)?;
    let cred = String::from_utf8_lossy(&decoded);
    let (account_name, raw_password) = match cred.split_once(':') {
        Some((u, p)) => (u.to_string(), p.to_string()),
        None => return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized),
    };

    let c = pool.get().await.map_err(|_| AuthError::Unauthorized)?;
    let auth_row = db::find_auth_user(&c, &account_name)
        .await
        .map_err(|_| AuthError::Unauthorized)?
        .ok_or(AuthError::Unauthorized)?;
    if !auth_row.active {
        return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized);
    }
    let stored = match &auth_row.password {
        Some(p) => p.clone(),
        None => return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized),
    };
    // BCryptPasswordEncoder.matches: false for malformed hashes
    let ok = bcrypt::verify(&raw_password, &stored).unwrap_or(false);
    if !ok {
        return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized);
    }
    let authorities = db::load_role_names(&c, auth_row.id)
        .await
        .map_err(|_| AuthError::Unauthorized)?;
    if authorities.is_empty() {
        // the provider returns an unauthenticated token -> 401 on every
        // secured endpoint
        return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized);
    }
    let member_of = db::load_memberships(&c, auth_row.id)
        .await
        .map_err(|_| AuthError::Unauthorized)?;
    let perms = db::load_principal_perms(&c, auth_row.id, &member_of)
        .await
        .map_err(|_| AuthError::Unauthorized)?;
    let is_admin = authorities.iter().any(|a| a == "ROLE_ADMIN");
    let has_user_role = is_admin || authorities.iter().any(|a| a == "ROLE_USER");
    Ok(Principal {
        id: auth_row.id,
        account_name: auth_row.account_name.unwrap_or(account_name),
        authorities,
        is_admin,
        has_user_role,
        member_of,
        perms,
    })
}

//! Database access: connection pool, entity loading (full / restricted /
//! filtered), id allocation from `hibernate_sequences` and principal/
//! permission loading, mirroring what Hibernate does in the original.

use chrono::{Local, NaiveDateTime};
pub use deadpool_postgres::Pool;
use tokio_postgres::{NoTls, Row};

use crate::javadoc;
use crate::model::*;

pub fn create_pool(database_url: &str) -> Result<Pool, String> {
    let pg_cfg: tokio_postgres::Config = database_url
        .parse()
        .map_err(|e: tokio_postgres::Error| format!("invalid DATABASE_URL: {}", e))?;
    let manager = deadpool_postgres::Manager::new(pg_cfg, NoTls);
    let pool = Pool::builder(manager)
        .max_size(10)
        .build()
        .map_err(|e| format!("pool build error: {}", e))?;
    Ok(pool)
}

pub fn now() -> NaiveDateTime {
    Local::now().naive_local()
}

/// Allocate the next id the way Hibernate's TableGenerator does:
/// new id = next_val + 1, then next_val = new id. Executed with autocommit so
/// the value is consumed even if the surrounding business transaction rolls
/// back (matching the original).
pub async fn next_id(pool: &Pool) -> Result<i32, String> {
    let c = pool.get().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let row = c
        .query_one(
            "INSERT INTO hibernate_sequences (sequence_name, next_val) VALUES ('default', 1)
             ON CONFLICT (sequence_name)
             DO UPDATE SET next_val = COALESCE(hibernate_sequences.next_val, 0) + 1
             RETURNING next_val",
            &[],
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let v: i64 = row.get("next_val");
    Ok(v as i32)
}

            USER_COLS_FULL, where_sql
        )
    } else {
        format!(

    let rows = if ids.is_some() {

    } else {

/// Attach roles (full) and user-group ids to already-loaded users.
pub async fn attach_user_collections(
    c: &tokio_postgres::Client,
    users: &mut [User],
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let ids: Vec<i32> = users.iter().filter_map(|u| u.id).collect();
    if ids.is_empty() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let role_rows = c
        .query(
            "SELECT ur.user_id AS uid, r.id, r.created, r.modified, r.name, r.description
             FROM users_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
             WHERE ur.user_id = ANY($1) ORDER BY r.id",
            &[&ids],
        )
        .await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let grp_rows = c
        .query(
            "SELECT user_id, usergroup_id FROM user_usergroup WHERE user_id = ANY($1) ORDER BY usergroup_id",
            &[&ids],
        )
        .await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut roles_by_user: std::collections::HashMap<i32, Vec<Role>> = Default::default();
    for r in &role_rows {
        let uid: i32 = r.get("uid");
        roles_by_user.entry(uid).or_default().push(role_from_row(r));
    }
    let mut groups_by_user: std::collections::HashMap<i32, Vec<i32>> = Default::default();
    for r in &grp_rows {
        let uid: i32 = r.get("user_id");
        groups_by_user.entry(uid).or_default().push(r.get("usergroup_id"));
    }
    for u in users.iter_mut() {
        if let Some(id) = u.id {
            u.roles = Some(roles_by_user.remove(&id).unwrap_or_default());
            u.user_group_ids = Some(groups_by_user.remove(&id).unwrap_or_default());
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub async fn load_user_full_by_id(

async fn attach_group_collections(
    c: &tokio_postgres::Client,
    groups: &mut [UserGroup],
    rows: &[Row],
    owner_ids: &[i32],
    gids: &[i32],
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let owners = if owner_ids.is_empty() {
        Vec::new()
    } else {
        load_users_full(c, Some(owner_ids), "", &[]).await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
    };
    let member_rows = c
        .query(
            "SELECT usergroup_id, user_id FROM user_usergroup WHERE usergroup_id = ANY($1) ORDER BY user_id",
            &[&gids],
        )
        .await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let member_ids: Vec<i32> = member_rows.iter().map(|r| r.get("user_id")).collect();
    let members = if member_ids.is_empty() {
        Vec::new()
    } else {
        load_users_full(c, Some(&member_ids), "", &[]).await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
    };
    let role_rows = c
        .query(
            "SELECT ur.usergroup_id AS gid, r.id, r.created, r.modified, r.name, r.description
             FROM usergroups_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
             WHERE ur.usergroup_id = ANY($1) ORDER BY r.id",
            &[&gids],
        )
        .await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    for g in groups.iter_mut() {
        let gid = match g.id {
            Some(v) => v,
            None => continue,
        };
        let owner_id: Option<i32> = rows
            .iter()
            .find(|r| r.get::<_, i32>("id") == gid)
            .and_then(|r| r.get::<_, Option<i32>>("owner_id"));
        if let Some(oid) = owner_id {
            g.owner = owners.iter().find(|u| u.id == Some(oid)).cloned().map(Box::new);
        }
        let member_ids_of_group: Vec<i32> = member_rows
            .iter()
            .filter(|r| r.get::<_, i32>("usergroup_id") == gid)
            .map(|r| r.get("user_id"))
            .collect();
        g.members = Some(
            members
                .iter()
                .filter(|u| member_ids_of_group.contains(&u.id.unwrap_or(-1)))
                .cloned()
                .collect(),
        );
        g.roles = Some(
            role_rows
                .iter()
                .filter(|r| r.get::<_, i32>("gid") == gid)
                .map(role_from_row)
                .collect(),
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

async fn datasources_from_rows(
    c: &tokio_postgres::Client,
    rows: &[Row],
) -> Result<Vec<DataSource>, String> {
    let mut dss: Vec<DataSource> = rows.iter().map(datasource_from_row).collect();
    if dss.is_empty() {
        return Ok(dss);
    }
    let mut tilegrid_ids: Vec<i32> = Vec::new();
    let mut xyz_extent_ids: Vec<i32> = Vec::new();
    let mut wmts_ids: Vec<i32> = Vec::new();
    let mut xyz_ids: Vec<i32> = Vec::new();
    for (ds, row) in dss.iter_mut().zip(rows.iter()) {
        match ds.kind {
            DsKind::TileWms => {
                if let Some(gid) = row.get::<_, Option<i32>>("tw_tilegrid_id") {
                    tilegrid_ids.push(gid);
                    let mut g = TileGrid::from_db(false);
                    g.id = Some(gid);
                    ds.tile_grid = Some(Box::new(g));
                }
            }
            DsKind::Wmts => {
                wmts_ids.push(ds.id.unwrap_or(-1));
                if let Some(gid) = row.get::<_, Option<i32>>("wmts_tilegrid_id") {
                    tilegrid_ids.push(gid);
                    let mut g = TileGrid::from_db(true);
                    g.id = Some(gid);
                    ds.tile_grid = Some(Box::new(g));
                }
            }
            DsKind::Xyz => {
                xyz_ids.push(ds.id.unwrap_or(-1));
                if let Some(eid) = row.get::<_, Option<i32>>("xyz_extent_id") {
                    xyz_extent_ids.push(eid);
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    let grids = load_tilegrids(c, &tilegrid_ids).await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let url_rows = if wmts_ids.is_empty() {
        Vec::new()
    } else {
        c.query(
            "SELECT wmtslayerdatasources_id, urls FROM wmtslayerdatasources_urls WHERE wmtslayerdatasources_id = ANY($1)",
            &[&wmts_ids],
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
    };
    let xyz_extents = load_extents(c, &xyz_extent_ids).await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let res_rows = if xyz_ids.is_empty() {
        Vec::new()
    } else {
        c.query(
            "SELECT xyzlayerdatasrc_id, resolution, idx FROM xyzlayerdatasrc_resolution WHERE xyzlayerdatasrc_id = ANY($1) ORDER BY idx",
            &[&xyz_ids],
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
    };
    for (ds, row) in dss.iter_mut().zip(rows.iter()) {
        let id = ds.id.unwrap_or(-1);
        match ds.kind {
            DsKind::TileWms | DsKind::Wmts => {
                let gid = ds.tile_grid.as_ref().and_then(|g| g.id);
                if let Some(gid) = gid {
                    if let Some(g) = grids.iter().find(|g| g.id == Some(gid)) {
                        ds.tile_grid = Some(Box::new(g.clone()));
                    }
                }
                if ds.kind == DsKind::Wmts {
                    ds.urls = Some(
                        url_rows
                            .iter()
                            .filter(|r| r.get::<_, i32>("wmtslayerdatasources_id") == id)
                            .map(|r| r.get::<_, Option<String>>("urls"))
                            .collect(),
                    );
                }
            }
            DsKind::Xyz => {
                if let Some(eid) = row.get::<_, Option<i32>>("xyz_extent_id") {
                    ds.extent = xyz_extents.iter().find(|e| e.id == Some(eid)).cloned().map(Box::new);
                }
                let mut list = Vec::new();
                for r in res_rows.iter().filter(|r| r.get::<_, i32>("xyzlayerdatasrc_id") == id) {
                    let blob: Option<Vec<u8>> = r.get("resolution");
                    match blob {
                        Some(b) => match javadoc::deserialize_point2d_double(&b) {
                            Some((x, y)) => list.push(Some(Point { x, y })),
                            None => list.push(None),
                        },
                        None => list.push(None),
                    }
                }
                ds.resolutions = Some(list);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    Ok(dss)
}

    let bytes = s.as_bytes();
    let mut out: Vec<u8> = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len());
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < bytes.len() {
        if bytes[i] == b'%' && i + 2 < bytes.len() {
            if let (Some(h), Some(l)) = (
                (bytes[i + 1] as char).to_digit(16),
                (bytes[i + 2] as char).to_digit(16),

fn build_filter(rt: ResourceType, mvm: &[(String, Vec<String>)]) -> Option<(String, Vec<FilterVal>)> {

    // (the inner loop of validFieldNamesWithCastedValues breaks after the
    // first match), in query order.
    let mut canon: Vec<(&'static str, Vec<String>)> = Vec::new();

            }
            if f.eq_ignore_ascii_case(k) {

    if canon.is_empty() {

                }
                FieldType::Double => FilterVal::D(javadoc::convert_utils_f64(v)),
            };
            ors.push(format!("{} = ${}", col, idx));
            params.push(fv);
        }
        clauses.push(format!("({})", ors.join(" OR ")));
    }
    Some((format!("WHERE {}", clauses.join(" AND ")), params))
}

fn boxes_for(params: &[FilterVal]) -> Vec<Box<dyn ToSqlAndSend>> {
    params
        .iter()
        .map(|v| match v {
            FilterVal::S(s) => Box::new(s.clone()) as Box<dyn ToSqlAndSend>,
            FilterVal::I(i) => Box::new(*i) as Box<dyn ToSqlAndSend>,
            FilterVal::B(b) => Box::new(*b) as Box<dyn ToSqlAndSend>,
            FilterVal::D(d) => Box::new(*d) as Box<dyn ToSqlAndSend>,
        })
        .collect()
}

pub trait ToSqlAndSend: ToSql + Sync + Send {}
impl<T: ToSql + Sync + Send> ToSqlAndSend for T {}

fn refs_for<'a>(boxes: &'a [Box<dyn ToSqlAndSend>]) -> Vec<&'a (dyn ToSql + Sync)> {
    boxes.iter().map(|b| b.as_ref() as &'a (dyn ToSql + Sync)).collect()
}

    fn to_json(&self) -> String {
        let mut out = String::new();
        match self {
            Loaded::User(e) => user_to_json(e, &mut out),
            Loaded::Group(e) => group_to_json(e, &mut out),
            Loaded::Role(e) => role_to_json(e, &mut out),
            Loaded::Layer(e) => layer_to_json(e, &mut out),
            Loaded::Ds(e) => datasource_to_json(e, &mut out),
            Loaded::App(e) => appearance_to_json(e, &mut out),
        }
        out
    }
    fn set_id(&mut self, id: i32) {
        match self {
            Loaded::User(e) => e.id = Some(id),
            Loaded::Group(e) => e.id = Some(id),
            Loaded::Role(e) => e.id = Some(id),
            Loaded::Layer(e) => e.id = Some(id),
            Loaded::Ds(e) => e.id = Some(id),
            Loaded::App(e) => e.id = Some(id),
        }

}

async fn load_one(
    c: &tokio_postgres::Client,
    rt: ResourceType,
    id: i32,
) -> Result<Option<Loaded>, String> {
    match rt {
        ResourceType::Users => Ok(db::load_user_full_by_id(c, id).await?.map(Loaded::User)),
        ResourceType::Groups => Ok(db::load_groups(c, Some(&[id]), "", &[]).await?.pop().map(Loaded::Group)),
        ResourceType::Roles => Ok(db::load_roles(c, Some(&[id]), "", &[]).await?.pop().map(Loaded::Role)),
        ResourceType::Layers => Ok(db::load_layers(c, Some(&[id]), "", &[]).await?.pop().map(Loaded::Layer)),
        ResourceType::DataSources => {
            let mut v = db::load_datasources(c, &[id]).await?;
            Ok(v.pop().map(Loaded::Ds))
        }
        ResourceType::Appearances => {
            Ok(db::load_appearances(c, Some(&[id])).await?.pop().map(Loaded::App))
        }
    }
}

fn conflicts_for(loaded: &Loaded) -> Conflicts {
    let mut cf = Conflicts::default();
    match loaded {
        Loaded::Layer(l) => {
            if let Some(a) = &l.appearance {
                if let Some(id) = a.id {
                    cf.appearance.push(id);
                }
            }
        }
        Loaded::Ds(d) => {
            if matches!(d.kind, DsKind::TileWms | DsKind::Wmts) {
                if let Some(g) = &d.tile_grid {
                    if let Some(id) = g.id {
                        cf.tilegrid.push(id);
                    }
                    if let Some(e) = &g.extent {
                        if let Some(id) = e.id {
                            cf.extent.push(id);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    cf
}

pub async fn rest_handler(State(state): State<AppState>, req: Request) -> Response {
    let method = req.method().clone();
    let path = req.uri().path().to_string();
    let query = req.uri().query().unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let headers: HeaderMap = req.headers().clone();
    let body: Bytes = match axum::body::to_bytes(req.into_body(), 64 * 1024 * 1024).await {
        Ok(b) => b,
        Err(_) => return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST),
    };

    let rest = path.strip_prefix("/rest").unwrap_or("");
    let trimmed = rest.trim_matches('/');
    let segments: Vec<String> = if trimmed.is_empty() {
        Vec::new()
    } else {
        trimmed.split('/').map(percent_decode).collect()
    };

    // Security filter chain runs before dispatch
    let principal = match auth::authenticate(&state.pool, &headers).await {
        Ok(p) => p,
        Err(auth::AuthError::Unauthorized) => return unauthorized(),
    };

    let rt = segments.first().and_then(|s| ResourceType::from_path(s));
    match rt {
        Some(_) => {
            if !principal.has_user_role {
                return empty(StatusCode::FORBIDDEN);
            }
        }
        None => {
            // all non-slice /rest endpoints are ROLE_ADMIN only
            if !principal.is_admin {
                return empty(StatusCode::FORBIDDEN);
            }
            return empty(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
        }
    }
    let rt = rt.unwrap();

    let is_get = method == Method::GET || method == Method::HEAD;
    let head_only = method == Method::HEAD;

    match segments.len() {
        1 => {
            if is_get {
                let r = handle_list(&state, rt, &query, &principal).await;
                if head_only { strip_body(r) } else { r }
            } else if method == Method::POST {
                handle_create(&state, rt, &body, &principal).await
            } else if method == Method::OPTIONS {
                options_ok("POST,GET,HEAD,OPTIONS")
            } else {
                method_not_allowed("GET,HEAD,POST")
            }
        }
        2 => {
            if is_get && segments[1] == "filter" {
                let r = handle_filter(&state, rt, &query, &principal).await;
                if head_only { strip_body(r) } else { r }
            } else if let Some(id) = parse_path_id(&segments[1]) {
                if is_get {
                    let r = handle_get_one(&state, rt, id, &principal).await;
                    if head_only { strip_body(r) } else { r }
                } else if method == Method::PUT {
                    handle_update(&state, rt, id, &body, &principal).await
                } else if method == Method::DELETE {
                    handle_delete(&state, rt, id, &principal).await
                } else if method == Method::OPTIONS {
                    options_ok("GET,HEAD,DELETE,PUT,OPTIONS")
                } else {
                    method_not_allowed("GET,HEAD,PUT,DELETE")
                }
            } else if is_get || method == Method::POST || method == Method::OPTIONS {
                // GET /rest/x/filter handled above; GET with bad id -> 400,
                // POST /rest/{res}/{anything} -> 405
                if method == Method::POST {
                    method_not_allowed("GET,HEAD,PUT,DELETE")
                } else if is_get && segments[1] != "filter" {
                    empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST)
                } else if method == Method::OPTIONS {
                    options_ok("GET,HEAD,DELETE,PUT,OPTIONS")
                } else {
                    method_not_allowed("GET,HEAD,OPTIONS")
                }
            } else {
                // PUT/DELETE with unparseable id (e.g. "filter") -> 400
                empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST)
            }
        }
        3 => {
            let id = match parse_path_id(&segments[1]) {
                Some(v) => v,
                None => return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST),
            };
            if rt == ResourceType::Users && segments[2] == "userGroups" {
                if is_get {
                    let r = handle_user_groups(&state, id, &principal).await;
                    if head_only { strip_body(r) } else { r }
                } else if method == Method::OPTIONS {
                    options_ok("GET,HEAD,OPTIONS")
                } else {
                    method_not_allowed("GET,HEAD,OPTIONS")
                }
            } else if rt == ResourceType::Groups && segments[2] == "users" {
                if is_get {
                    let r = handle_group_users(&state, id, &principal).await;
                    if head_only { strip_body(r) } else { r }
                } else if method == Method::OPTIONS {
                    options_ok("GET,HEAD,OPTIONS")
                } else {
                    method_not_allowed("GET,HEAD,OPTIONS")
                }
            } else {
                empty(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND)
            }
        }
        _ => empty(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND),
    }
}

fn strip_body(r: Response) -> Response {
    let (parts, _) = r.into_parts();
    Response::from_parts(parts, Body::empty())
}

/// Spring's StringToNumber conversion for @PathVariable Integer/int.
fn parse_path_id(s: &str) -> Option<i32> {
    let t = s.trim();
    if t.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    match t.parse::<i64>() {
        Ok(v) => {
            if v >= i32::MIN as i64 && v <= i32::MAX as i64 {
                Some(v as i32)
            } else {
                None
            }
        }
        Err(_) => None,
    }
}

pub async fn other_handler(_req: Request) -> Response {
    // everything outside /rest is out of scope for this service
    empty(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND)
}

async fn handle_list(state: &AppState, rt: ResourceType, query: &str, principal: &Principal) -> Response {

}

async fn handle_filter(state: &AppState, rt: ResourceType, query: &str, principal: &Principal) -> Response {
    let mvm = parse_query(query);
    let restrict = determine_restrict_fields(&mvm, rt);
    let filter = match build_filter(rt, &mvm) {
        None => return json_response(StatusCode::OK, "[]".to_string()),
        Some(f) => f,
    };
    let boxes = boxes_for(&filter.1);
    let refs = refs_for(&boxes);
    load_list(state, rt, &filter.0, &refs, restrict, principal).await
}

async fn load_list(
    state: &AppState,
    rt: ResourceType,
    where_sql: &str,
    params: &[&(dyn ToSql + Sync)],
    restrict: Option<Vec<String>>,
    principal: &Principal,
) -> Response {
    let c = match state.pool.get().await {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("pool error: {}", e);
            return internal_error();
        }
    };

    // The original blows up (HTTP 500) when a restricted projection is
    // transformed into the abstract LayerDataSource class - but only when at
    // least one row is returned.
    if rt == ResourceType::DataSources && restrict.is_some() {
        let n = match db::count_datasources_where(&c, where_sql, params).await {
            Ok(n) => n,
            Err(_) => return internal_error(),
        };
        return if n > 0 {
            internal_error()
        } else {
            json_response(StatusCode::OK, "[]".to_string())
        };
    }

    let restricted = restrict.is_some();
    let mut out = String::from("[");
    let mut first = true;
    let push = |out: &mut String, first: &mut bool, s: String| {
        if !*first {
            out.push(',');
        }
        *first = false;
        out.push_str(&s);
    };

    macro_rules! serialize_filtered {
        ($items:expr, $ser:expr) => {{
            let items = $items;
            for e in items.iter() {
                let id = match e.id {
                    Some(i) => Some(i),
                    None => None,
                };
                if has_permission(principal, rt, id, Permission::Read, restricted) {
                    let mut s = String::new();
                    $ser(e, &mut s);
                    push(&mut out, &mut first, s);
                }
            }
        }};
    }

    let result = async {
        match rt {
            ResourceType::Users => {
                if let Some(fields) = &restrict {
                    let items = db::load_users_restricted(&c, fields, where_sql, params).await?;
                    serialize_filtered!(items, user_to_json);
                } else {
                    let items = db::load_users_full(&c, None, where_sql, params)
                        .await
                        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                    serialize_filtered!(items, user_to_json);
                }
            }
            ResourceType::Groups => {
                if let Some(fields) = &restrict {
                    let items = db::load_groups_restricted(&c, fields, where_sql, params).await?;
                    serialize_filtered!(items, group_to_json);
                } else {
                    let items = db::load_groups(&c, None, where_sql, params)
                        .await
                        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                    serialize_filtered!(items, group_to_json);
                }
            }
            ResourceType::Roles => {
                if let Some(fields) = &restrict {
                    let items = db::load_roles_restricted(&c, fields, where_sql, params).await?;
                    serialize_filtered!(items, role_to_json);
                } else {
                    let items = db::load_roles(&c, None, where_sql, params)
                        .await
                        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                    serialize_filtered!(items, role_to_json);
                }
            }
            ResourceType::Layers => {
                if let Some(fields) = &restrict {
                    let items = db::load_layers_restricted(&c, fields, where_sql, params).await?;
                    serialize_filtered!(items, layer_to_json);
                } else {
                    let items = db::load_layers(&c, None, where_sql, params)
                        .await
                        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                    serialize_filtered!(items, layer_to_json);
                }
            }
            ResourceType::DataSources => {
                let items = db::load_datasources_where(&c, where_sql, params).await?;
                serialize_filtered!(items, datasource_to_json);
            }
            ResourceType::Appearances => {
                if let Some(fields) = &restrict {
                    let items = db::load_appearances_restricted(&c, fields, where_sql, params).await?;
                    serialize_filtered!(items, appearance_to_json);
                } else {
                    let items = db::load_appearances_where(&c, where_sql, params)
                        .await
                        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                    serialize_filtered!(items, appearance_to_json);
                }
            }
        }
        Ok::<(), String>(())
    }
    .await;

    if let Err(e) = result {
        eprintln!("list error: {}", e);
        return internal_error();
    }
    out.push(']');
    json_response(StatusCode::OK, out)
}

async fn handle_create(state: &AppState, rt: ResourceType, body: &[u8], principal: &Principal) -> Response {
    // The original cannot instantiate the abstract LayerDataSource at all.
    if rt == ResourceType::DataSources {
        return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
    }
    let value: Value = match serde_json::from_slice(body) {
        Ok(v) => v,
        Err(_) => return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST),
    };
    if !value.is_object() {
        return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
    }
    let c = match state.pool.get().await {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(_) => return internal_error(),
    };
    let ctx = ApplyCtx {
        client: &c,
        principal_is_admin: principal.is_admin,
        principal_member_of: &principal.member_of,
        group_perms: &principal.perms.group_perms,
    };
    let mut loaded = match rt {
        ResourceType::Users => {
            let mut e = User::new_fresh();
            if apply_user(&mut e, &value, &ctx, None).await.is_err() {
                return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
            }
            Loaded::User(e)
        }
        ResourceType::Groups => {
            let mut e = UserGroup::new_fresh();
            if apply_group(&mut e, &value, &ctx, None).await.is_err() {
                return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
            }
            Loaded::Group(e)
        }
        ResourceType::Roles => {
            let mut e = Role::new_fresh();
            if apply_role(&mut e, &value).is_err() {
                return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
            }
            Loaded::Role(e)
        }
        ResourceType::Layers => {
            let mut e = Layer::new_fresh();
            if apply_layer(&mut e, &value, &ctx, None).await.is_err() {
                return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
            }
            Loaded::Layer(e)
        }
        ResourceType::Appearances => {
            let mut e = LayerAppearance::new_fresh();
            if apply_appearance(&mut e, &value, None).is_err() {
                return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
            }
            Loaded::App(e)
        }
        ResourceType::DataSources => unreachable!(),
    };
    // ID value MUST be null to assure that saveOrUpdate will save and not update
    if loaded.id().is_some() {
        return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
    }
    if !has_permission(principal, rt, None, Permission::Create, false) {
        return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
    }
    // id allocation happens in its own transaction (consumed even on rollback)
    match &mut loaded {
        Loaded::Layer(l) => {
            if let Err(e) = persist::assign_ids_create_layer(&state.pool, l).await {
                return match e {
                    WriteError::Infra(_) => internal_error(),
                    WriteError::Runtime => empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST),
                };
            }
        }
        other => {
            match persist::assign_ids_root(&state.pool).await {
                Ok(id) => other.set_id(id),
                Err(e) => {
                    return match e {
                        WriteError::Infra(_) => internal_error(),
                        WriteError::Runtime => empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST),
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let conflicts = Conflicts::default();
    match run_insert(&state.pool, &loaded, &conflicts).await {
        Ok(()) => json_response(StatusCode::CREATED, loaded.to_json()),
        Err(WriteError::Runtime) => empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST),
        Err(WriteError::Infra(e)) => {
            eprintln!("infra error: {}", e);
            internal_error()
        }
    }
}

async fn run_insert(pool: &db::Pool, loaded: &Loaded, conflicts: &Conflicts) -> persist::WResult<()> {
    let mut c = pool.get().await.map_err(|e| WriteError::Infra(e.to_string()))?;
    let tx = (&mut **c).transaction().await.map_err(|e| WriteError::Infra(e.to_string()))?;
    let res = match loaded {
        Loaded::User(e) => persist::insert_user(&tx, e).await,
        Loaded::Group(e) => persist::insert_group(&tx, e).await,
        Loaded::Role(e) => persist::insert_role(&tx, e).await,
        Loaded::Layer(e) => persist::insert_layer(&tx, e, conflicts).await,
        Loaded::App(e) => persist::insert_appearance(&tx, e).await,
        Loaded::Ds(_) => Err(WriteError::Runtime),
    };
    match res {
        Ok(()) => tx.commit().await.map_err(|e| WriteError::Infra(e.to_string())),
        Err(e) => {
            let _ = tx.rollback().await;
            Err(e)
        }
    }
}

async fn handle_update(
    state: &AppState,
    rt: ResourceType,
    id: i32,
    body: &[u8],
    principal: &Principal,
) -> Response {
    // empty body -> "The JSON body is empty" -> 400
    let trimmed = std::str::from_utf8(body).map(|s| s.trim()).unwrap_or("");
    if trimmed.is_empty() {
        return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
    }
    let tree: Value = match serde_json::from_slice(body) {
        Ok(v) => v,
        Err(_) => return empty(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND), // IOException -> NOT_FOUND
    };
    let id_node = match tree.get("id") {
        Some(v) => v.clone(),
        None => return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST),
    };
    if !tree.is_object() {
        return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
    }
    if json_id_as_int(&id_node) != id {
        return empty(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    let c = match state.pool.get().await {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(_) => return internal_error(),
    };
    let mut loaded = match load_one(&c, rt, id).await {
        Ok(Some(l)) => l,
        Ok(None) => return empty(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND),
        Err(_) => return internal_error(),
    };
    if !has_permission(principal, rt, loaded.id(), Permission::Read, false) {
        return empty(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
    }
    if !has_permission(principal, rt, loaded.id(), Permission::Update, false) {
        return empty(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
    }
    let conflicts = conflicts_for(&loaded);
    let ctx = ApplyCtx {
        client: &c,
        principal_is_admin: principal.is_admin,
        principal_member_of: &principal.member_of,
        group_perms: &principal.perms.group_perms,
    };
    let mut mutation = Mutation::default();
    let apply_res = match &mut loaded {
        Loaded::User(e) => apply_user(e, &tree, &ctx, Some(&mut mutation)).await,
        Loaded::Group(e) => apply_group(e, &tree, &ctx, Some(&mut mutation)).await,
        Loaded::Role(e) => apply_role(e, &tree),
        Loaded::Layer(e) => apply_layer(e, &tree, &ctx, Some(&mut mutation)).await,
        Loaded::Ds(e) => apply_datasource(e, &tree, &ctx, Some(&mut mutation)).await,
        Loaded::App(e) => apply_appearance(e, &tree, Some(&mut mutation)),
    };
    match apply_res {
        Err(_) => {
            // checked exception: the already-applied field changes are still
            // flushed and committed by the original (no rollback for checked
            // exceptions), the response is 404.
            let _ = run_update(&state.pool, &mut loaded, &mutation, &conflicts, false).await;
            empty(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND)
        }
        Ok(()) => {
            // allocate ids for fresh cascaded nested entities
            if let Err(e) = assign_nested_ids(&state.pool, &mut loaded).await {
                return match e {
                    WriteError::Infra(_) => internal_error(),
                    WriteError::Runtime => empty(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND),
                };
            }
            match run_update(&state.pool, &mut loaded, &mutation, &conflicts, true).await {
                Ok(()) => json_response(StatusCode::OK, loaded.to_json()),
                Err(WriteError::Runtime) => empty(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND),
                Err(WriteError::Infra(e)) => {
                    eprintln!("infra error: {}", e);
                    internal_error()
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

async fn assign_nested_ids(pool: &db::Pool, loaded: &mut Loaded) -> persist::WResult<()> {
    match loaded {
        Loaded::Layer(l) => {
            if let Some(a) = l.appearance.as_mut() {
                if a.fresh && a.id.is_none() {
                    a.id = Some(db::next_id(pool).await.map_err(WriteError::Infra)?);
                    a.needs_insert = true;
                }
            }
        }
        Loaded::Ds(d) => {
            if let Some(g) = d.tile_grid.as_mut() {
                if g.fresh {
                    persist::assign_grid_ids(pool, g).await?;
                }
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    Ok(())
}

async fn run_update(
    pool: &db::Pool,
    loaded: &mut Loaded,
    m: &Mutation,
    conflicts: &Conflicts,
    _set_modified: bool,
) -> persist::WResult<()> {
    let mut c = pool.get().await.map_err(|e| WriteError::Infra(e.to_string()))?;
    let tx = (&mut **c).transaction().await.map_err(|e| WriteError::Infra(e.to_string()))?;
    let res = match loaded {
        Loaded::User(e) => persist::update_user(&tx, e, m).await,

            let t = s.trim();
            match t.parse::<i64>() {
                Ok(i) => {
                    if i > i32::MAX as i64 || i < i32::MIN as i64 {
                        Err(JacksonError)
                    } else {
                        Ok(Some(i as i32))
                    }
                }
                Err(_) => match t.parse::<f64>() {
                    Ok(f) if f.is_finite() => Ok(Some(f as i32)),
                    _ => Err(JacksonError),
                },
            }
        }
        Value::Bool(b) => Ok(Some(if *b { 1 } else { 0 })),
        _ => Err(JacksonError),
    }
}

fn to_prim_i32(v: &Value) -> JResult<i32> {
    Ok(to_opt_i32(v)?.unwrap_or(0))
}

fn to_opt_f64(v: &Value) -> JResult<Option<f64>> {
    match v {
        Value::Null => Ok(None),
        Value::Number(n) => match n.as_f64() {
            Some(f) => Ok(Some(f)),
            None => Err(JacksonError),
        },
        Value::String(s) => {
            let t = s.trim();
            if t.eq_ignore_ascii_case("nan") {
                return Ok(Some(f64::NAN));
            }
            match t.parse::<f64>() {
                Ok(f) => Ok(Some(f)),
                Err(_) => Err(JacksonError),
            }
        }
        Value::Bool(b) => Ok(Some(if *b { 1.0 } else { 0.0 })),
        _ => Err(JacksonError),
    }
}

fn to_opt_bool(v: &Value) -> JResult<Option<bool>> {
    match v {
        Value::Null => Ok(None),
        Value::Bool(b) => Ok(Some(*b)),
        Value::Number(n) => {
            if let Some(i) = n.as_i64() {
                Ok(Some(i != 0))
            } else if let Some(f) = n.as_f64() {
                Ok(Some(f != 0.0))
            } else {
                Err(JacksonError)
            }
        }
        Value::String(s) => {
            let t = s.trim();
            if t.eq_ignore_ascii_case("true") {
                Ok(Some(true))
            } else if t.eq_ignore_ascii_case("false") || t.is_empty() {
                Ok(Some(false))
            } else {
                Err(JacksonError)
            }
        }
        _ => Err(JacksonError),
    }
}

fn to_prim_bool(v: &Value) -> JResult<bool> {
    Ok(to_opt_bool(v)?.unwrap_or(false))
}

fn to_opt_date(v: &Value) -> JResult<Option<chrono::NaiveDate>> {
    match v {
        Value::Null => Ok(None),
        Value::String(s) => {
            let t = s.trim();
            if let Ok(d) = chrono::NaiveDate::parse_from_str(t, "%Y-%m-%d") {
                return Ok(Some(d));
            }
            // Joda's local date parser accepts non zero-padded parts and a
            // trailing time part; approximate with a manual split.
            let date_part = t.split(['T', ' ']).next().unwrap_or(t);
            let parts: Vec<&str> = date_part.split('-').collect();
            if parts.len() == 3 {
                if let (Ok(y), Ok(m), Ok(d)) = (
                    parts[0].parse::<i32>(),
                    parts[1].parse::<u32>(),
                    parts[2].parse::<u32>(),
                ) {
                    if let Some(date) = chrono::NaiveDate::from_ymd_opt(y, m, d) {
                        return Ok(Some(date));
                    }
                }
            }
            Err(JacksonError)
        }
        _ => Err(JacksonError),
    }
}

fn to_opt_locale(v: &Value) -> JResult<Option<String>> {
    match v {
        Value::Null => Ok(None),
        Value::String(s) => Ok(Some(normalize_locale(s))),
        _ => Err(JacksonError),
    }
}

fn to_opt_point(v: &Value) -> JResult<Option<Point>> {
    match v {
        Value::Null => Ok(None),
        Value::Object(m) => {
            let mut p = Point { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 };
            for (k, val) in m.iter() {
                match k.as_str() {
                    "x" => p.x = to_opt_f64(val)?.unwrap_or(0.0),
                    "y" => p.y = to_opt_f64(val)?.unwrap_or(0.0),
                    "location" => {} // read-only property, silently skipped
                    _ => return Err(JacksonError),
                }
            }
            Ok(Some(p))
        }
        _ => Err(JacksonError),
    }
}

    "userGroups",
];

pub async fn apply_user(
    u: &mut User,
    v: &Value,
    ctx: &ApplyCtx<'_>,
    mut m: Option<&mut Mutation>,
) -> JResult<()> {
    let map = obj(v)?;
    for (k, val) in map.iter() {
        check_known(k, USER_PROPS)?;
        match k.as_str() {
            "id" => u.id = to_opt_i32(val)?,
            "firstName" => u.first_name = to_opt_string(val)?,
            "lastName" => u.last_name = to_opt_string(val)?,
            "email" => u.email = to_opt_string(val)?,
            "birthday" => u.birthday = to_opt_date(val)?,
            "language" => u.language = to_opt_locale(val)?,
            "accountName" => u.account_name = to_opt_string(val)?,
            "password" => u.password = to_opt_string(val)?,
            "active" => u.active = to_prim_bool(val)?,
            "roles" => match val {
                Value::Null => {
                    u.roles = None;
                    if let Some(mm) = m.as_deref_mut() {
                        mm.set_collection("roles");
                    }
                }
                Value::Array(arr) => {
                    let mut roles = Vec::new();
                    for item in arr {
                        if item.is_null() {
                            // null element ends up in the set and fails at flush
                            roles.push(Role::new_fresh());
                        } else {
                            roles.push(build_role(item)?);
                        }
                    }
                    dedup_roles(&mut roles);
                    u.roles = Some(roles);
                    if let Some(mm) = m.as_deref_mut() {
                        mm.set_collection("roles");
                    }
                }
                _ => return Err(JacksonError),
            },
            "userGroups" => match val {
                Value::Null => {
                    u.user_group_ids = None;
                    if let Some(mm) = m.as_deref_mut() {
                        mm.set_collection("userGroups");
                    }
                }
                Value::Array(arr) => {
                    let mut ids: Vec<i32> = Vec::new();
                    for item in arr {
                        let id_val = match item {
                            Value::Object(om) => match om.get("id") {
                                Some(iv) => iv.clone(),
                                None => return Err(JacksonError),
                            },
                            other => other.clone(),
                        };
                        let gid = match to_opt_i32(&id_val)? {
                            Some(i) => i,
                            None => return Err(JacksonError),
                        };
                        // resolveId: the group must exist (a checked error here
                        // mirrors the JsonMappingException wrapping the
                        // ObjectNotFoundException), and non-admin principals
                        // need READ permission on it (loadById @PostAuthorize).
                        let exists = crate::db::exists(ctx.client, "usergroups", gid)
                            .await
                            .map_err(|_| JacksonError)?;
                        if !exists {
                            return Err(JacksonError);
                        }
                        if !ctx.principal_is_admin {
                            let readable = ctx.principal_member_of.contains(&gid)
                                || ctx
                                    .group_perms
                                    .get(&gid)
                                    .map(|ps| {
                                        ps.contains(&Permission::Read) || ps.contains(&Permission::Admin)
                                    })
                                    .unwrap_or(false);
                            if !readable {
                                return Err(JacksonError);
                            }
                        }
                        if !ids.contains(&gid) {
                            ids.push(gid);
                        }
                    }
                    u.user_group_ids = Some(ids);
                    if let Some(mm) = m.as_deref_mut() {
                        mm.set_collection("userGroups");
                    }
                }
                _ => return Err(JacksonError),
            },
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn dedup_roles(roles: &mut Vec<Role>) {
    let mut out: Vec<Role> = Vec::new();
    for r in roles.drain(..) {
        if !out.iter().any(|o| o.java_equals(&r)) {
            out.push(r);
        }
    }
    *roles = out;
}

pub fn dedup_users(users: &mut Vec<User>) {
    let mut out: Vec<User> = Vec::new();
    for u in users.drain(..) {
        if !out.iter().any(|o| o.java_equals(&u)) {
            out.push(u);
        }
    }
    *users = out;
}

//! Helpers that replicate Java/JDK formatting and parsing semantics.

/// Format an f64 exactly like `java.lang.Double.toString` (which Jackson uses
/// when writing JSON numbers).
///
/// Java rules: shortest decimal digits that uniquely identify the value;
/// plain notation when 10^-3 <= |v| < 10^7, otherwise scientific notation with
/// one digit before the decimal point and an "E" exponent.
pub fn java_double_to_string(v: f64) -> String {
    if v.is_nan() {
        return "NaN".to_string();
    }
    if v.is_infinite() {
        return if v > 0.0 { "Infinity".to_string() } else { "-Infinity".to_string() };
    }
    if v == 0.0 {
        return if v.is_sign_negative() { "-0.0".to_string() } else { "0.0".to_string() };
    }
    let neg = v < 0.0;
    let a = v.abs();
    // Shortest round-trip digits: Rust's LowerExp uses the same shortest
    // representation algorithm as Display, e.g. "2.002637639e7", "5e-3".
    let sci = format!("{:e}", a);
    let (mant, exp) = sci.split_once('e').unwrap();
    let exp: i32 = exp.parse().unwrap();
    let mut digits: String = mant.chars().filter(|c| *c != '.').collect();
    // strip trailing zeros (shortest form may still carry them, e.g. "1.0e20")
    while digits.len() > 1 && digits.ends_with('0') {
        digits.pop();
    }

    let mut out = String::new();
    if neg {
        out.push('-');
    }
    if exp >= -3 && exp < 7 {
        // plain notation: value = digits * 10^(exp - (digits.len()-1))
        // decimal point sits after (exp+1) digits
        let point = exp + 1;
        if point <= 0 {
            out.push_str("0.");
            for _ in 0..(-point) {
                out.push('0');
            }
            out.push_str(&digits);
        } else {
            let n = point as usize;
            if digits.len() <= n {
                out.push_str(&digits);
                for _ in digits.len()..n {
                    out.push('0');
                }
                out.push_str(".0");
            } else {
                out.push_str(&digits[..n]);
                out.push('.');
                out.push_str(&digits[n..]);
            }
        }
    } else {
        // scientific notation: d.dddEexp
        out.push_str(&digits[..1]);
        out.push('.');
        if digits.len() == 1 {
            out.push('0');
        } else {
            out.push_str(&digits[1..]);
        }
        out.push('E');
        out.push_str(&exp.to_string());
    }
    out
}

    // java.lang.Double.parseDouble accepts hexadecimal floating point "0x1p3"
    if let Some(v) = parse_java_hex_float(t) {
        return v;
    }
    if t.eq_ignore_ascii_case("nan") {
        return f64::NAN;
    }
    if t.eq_ignore_ascii_case("infinity") {

fn parse_java_hex_float(t: &str) -> Option<f64> {
    let lower = t.to_lowercase();
    let (neg, rest) = match lower.strip_prefix('-') {
        Some(r) => (true, r),
        None => (false, lower.as_str()),
    };
    let s = rest.strip_prefix("0x")?;
    let (mant, exp) = match s.split_once('p') {
        Some((m, e)) => (m, e.parse::<i32>().ok()?),
        None => (s, 0),
    };
    let (int_part, frac_part) = match mant.split_once('.') {
        Some((i, f)) => (i, f),
        None => (mant, ""),
    };
    if int_part.is_empty() && frac_part.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    let mut value: f64 = 0.0;
    for c in int_part.chars() {
        value = value * 16.0 + c.to_digit(16)? as f64;
    }
    let mut scale = 1.0 / 16.0;
    for c in frac_part.chars() {
        value += c.to_digit(16)? as f64 * scale;
        scale /= 16.0;
    }
    let r = value * 2f64.powi(exp);
    Some(if neg { -r } else { r })
}

/// Mimic `org.apache.commons.lang3.math.NumberUtils.isParsable`.
pub fn number_utils_is_parsable(str: &str) -> bool {
    if str.is_empty() {
        return false;
    }
    let bytes = str.as_bytes();
    let last = bytes[bytes.len() - 1];
    if !last.is_ascii_digit() {
        return false;
    }
    if !bytes[0].is_ascii_digit() && bytes[0] != b'-' && bytes[0] != b'.' {
        return false;
    }
    if str.contains("0x") || str.contains("0X") {
        return false;
    }
    let body = if bytes[0] == b'-' { &str[1..] } else { str };
    if body.is_empty() {
        return false;
    }
    let mut dots = 0usize;
    let mut es = 0usize;
    let mut digits = 0usize;
    let chars: Vec<char> = body.chars().collect();
    for (i, c) in chars.iter().enumerate() {
        match c {
            '0'..='9' => digits += 1,
            '.' => {
                dots += 1;
                if dots > 1 {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            'e' | 'E' => {
                es += 1;
                if es > 1 {
                    return false;
                }
                let rest: String = chars[i + 1..].iter().collect();
                let rest = rest.strip_prefix('+').or_else(|| rest.strip_prefix('-')).unwrap_or(&rest);
                if rest.is_empty() || !rest.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            '+' | '-' => {
                if i == 0 || (chars[i - 1] != 'e' && chars[i - 1] != 'E') {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            _ => return false,
        }
    }
    digits > 0
}

/// Mimic `java.lang.Object.toString()` for arbitrary Jackson-deserialized
/// values (used by PropertyValueConverter.convertToDatabaseColumn).
pub fn java_value_to_string(v: &serde_json::Value) -> String {
    match v {
        serde_json::Value::Null => "null".to_string(),
        serde_json::Value::Bool(b) => b.to_string(),
        serde_json::Value::Number(n) => java_number_to_string(n),
        serde_json::Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
        serde_json::Value::Array(arr) => {
            let mut out = String::from("[");
            for (i, item) in arr.iter().enumerate() {
                if i > 0 {
                    out.push_str(", ");
                }
                out.push_str(&java_value_to_string(item));
            }
            out.push(']');
            out
        }
        serde_json::Value::Object(map) => {
            let mut out = String::from("{");
            for (i, (k, val)) in map.iter().enumerate() {
                if i > 0 {
                    out.push_str(", ");
                }
                out.push_str(k);
                out.push('=');
                out.push_str(&java_value_to_string(val));
            }
            out.push('}');
            out
        }
    }
}

/// not in exactly that format.
pub fn deserialize_point2d_double(data: &[u8]) -> Option<(f64, f64)> {
    let prefix = point2d_prefix();
    if data.len() != prefix.len() + 16 {
        return None;
    }
    if data[..prefix.len()] != prefix[..] {
        return None;
    }
    let x = u64::from_be_bytes(data[prefix.len()..prefix.len() + 8].try_into().unwrap());
    let y = u64::from_be_bytes(data[prefix.len() + 8..prefix.len() + 16].try_into().unwrap());
    Some((f64::from_bits(x), f64::from_bits(y)))
}

    // connects lazily anyway.
    {
        let pool = pool.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            for _ in 0..60 {
                if let Ok(c) = pool.get().await {
                    if c.execute("SELECT 1", &[]).await.is_ok() {
                        return;
                    }
                }
                tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
            }
        });

        eprintln!("could not bind to {}: {}", addr, e);
        std::process::exit(1);

pub fn datasource_from_row(row: &Row) -> DataSource {
    let is_img: bool = row.get("is_img");
    let is_tile: bool = row.get("is_tile");
    let is_wfs: bool = row.get("is_wfs");
    let is_wmts: bool = row.get("is_wmts");
    let is_xyz: bool = row.get("is_xyz");
    let kind = if is_tile {
        DsKind::TileWms
    } else if is_img {
        DsKind::ImageWms
    } else if is_wfs {
        DsKind::Wfs
    } else if is_wmts {
        DsKind::Wmts
    } else if is_xyz {
        DsKind::Xyz
    } else {
        DsKind::Base
    };
    let mut ds = DataSource::new_loaded(kind);
    ds.id = row.get("id");
    ds.created = get_opt(row, "created");
    ds.modified = get_opt(row, "modified");
    ds.name = get_opt(row, "name");
    ds.ds_type = get_opt(row, "type");
    ds.url = get_opt(row, "url");
    ds.format = get_opt(row, "format");
    match kind {
        DsKind::ImageWms | DsKind::TileWms => {
            ds.width = row.get::<_, Option<i32>>("width").unwrap_or(0);
            ds.height = row.get::<_, Option<i32>>("height").unwrap_or(0);
            ds.version = get_opt(row, "version");
            ds.layer_names = get_opt(row, "layernames");
            ds.layer_styles = get_opt(row, "layerstyles");
            ds.requestable_by_path = get_opt(row, "requestablebypath");
            ds.custom_request_path = get_opt(row, "customrequestpath");
            if kind == DsKind::TileWms {
                ds.request_with_tiled = get_opt(row, "request_with_tiled");
            }
        }
        DsKind::Wfs => {
            ds.version = get_opt(row, "wfs_version");
            ds.type_name = get_opt(row, "typename");
            ds.type_names = get_opt(row, "typenames");
        }
        DsKind::Wmts => {
            ds.capabilities_url = get_opt(row, "capabilitiesurl");
            ds.matrix_set = get_opt(row, "matrixset");
            ds.projection = get_opt(row, "projection");
            ds.request_encoding = get_opt(row, "requestencoding");
            ds.wmts_layer = get_opt(row, "wmtslayer");
            ds.wmts_style = get_opt(row, "wmtsstyle");
        }
        DsKind::Xyz => {
            ds.center = point_from(get_opt(row, "center_x"), get_opt(row, "center_y"));
            ds.tile_size = get_opt(row, "xyz_tilesize");
        }
        DsKind::Base => {}
    }
    ds
}

/// Column list for loading data sources (with subtype left joins).
pub const DS_SELECT: &str = "SELECT d.id, d.created, d.modified, d.name, d.type, d.url, d.format, \
     (i.id IS NOT NULL) AS is_img, (t.id IS NOT NULL) AS is_tile, (w.id IS NOT NULL) AS is_wfs, \
     (m.id IS NOT NULL) AS is_wmts, (x.id IS NOT NULL) AS is_xyz, \
     i.width, i.height, i.version, i.layernames, i.layerstyles, i.requestablebypath, i.customrequestpath, \
     t.tilegrid_id AS tw_tilegrid_id, t.request_with_tiled, \
     w.version AS wfs_version, w.typename, w.typenames, \
     m.tilegrid_id AS wmts_tilegrid_id, m.capabilitiesurl, m.matrixset, m.projection, m.requestencoding, m.wmtslayer, m.wmtsstyle, \
     x.center_x, x.center_y, x.tilesize AS xyz_tilesize, x.extent_id AS xyz_extent_id \
     FROM layerdatasources d \
     LEFT JOIN imagewmslayerdatasources i ON i.id = d.id \
     LEFT JOIN tilewmslayerdatasources t ON t.id = d.id \
     LEFT JOIN wfslayerdatasources w ON w.id = d.id \
     LEFT JOIN wmtslayerdatasources m ON m.id = d.id \
     LEFT JOIN xyzlayerdatasources x ON x.id = d.id";

//! The security context: the authenticated principal and the entity permission
//! evaluators of `de.terrestris.shoguncore.security.access`.

use crate::model::{Permission, PrincipalPerms, ResourceType};

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Principal {
    pub id: i32,
    pub account_name: String,
    pub authorities: Vec<String>,
    pub is_admin: bool,
    /// hasRole('ROLE_USER') with the ROLE_ADMIN > ROLE_USER hierarchy
    pub has_user_role: bool,
    pub member_of: Vec<i32>,
    pub perms: PrincipalPerms,
}

/// Mimics ShogunCorePermissionEvaluator + the entity evaluators of the
/// EntityPermissionEvaluatorFactory.
///
/// `restricted` marks entities produced by an `output:only` projection: they
/// carry no permission data and their `created` timestamp differs from any
/// loaded entity, so the "own user" and "group member" special rules can never
/// apply to them.
pub fn has_permission(
    p: &Principal,
    rt: ResourceType,
    entity_id: Option<i32>,
    perm: Permission,
    restricted: bool,
) -> bool {
    if p.is_admin {
        return true;
    }
    if restricted {
        // entities from an output:only projection carry no permission data and
        // never match the "own user" / "member" equals checks
        return rt.always_allow_read() && perm == Permission::Read;
    }
    let id = match entity_id {
        Some(i) => i,
        None => return false,
    };
    match rt {
        // UserPermissionEvaluator: READ on the own user object
        ResourceType::Users => {
            if perm == Permission::Read && id == p.id {
                return true;
            }
        }
        // UserGroupPermissionEvaluator: READ on groups where the user is a member
        ResourceType::Groups => {
            if perm == Permission::Read && p.member_of.contains(&id) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        // AlwaysAllowReadPermissionEvaluator types
        ResourceType::Roles | ResourceType::DataSources | ResourceType::Appearances => {
            if perm == Permission::Read {
                return true;
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    // Permission collections stored on the entity
    if let Some(ps) = p.perms.user_perms.get(&id) {
        if ps.contains(&perm) || ps.contains(&Permission::Admin) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    if let Some(ps) = p.perms.group_perms.get(&id) {
        if ps.contains(&perm) || ps.contains(&Permission::Admin) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    false
}

/// Errors of the write phase. `Runtime` mirrors a Java RuntimeException
/// (NonUniqueObjectException, TransientObjectException, StStateException,
/// constraint violations, NPEs): the transaction is rolled back and the
/// controller reports 400 (POST) / 404 (PUT/DELETE).
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum WriteError {
    Runtime,
    Infra(String),
}

pub type WResult<T> = Result<T, WriteError>;

pub use crate::model::Mutation;

/// Loaded entity ids that are attached to the "session"; re-attaching a
/// detached instance with the same id through a cascading association triggers
/// Hibernate's NonUniqueObjectException.
#[derive(Default, Clone)]

    pub appearance: Vec<i32>,
    pub tilegrid: Vec<i32>,
    pub extent: Vec<i32>,

async fn exec(c: &(impl tokio_postgres::GenericClient + Sync), sql: &str, params: &[&(dyn ToSql + Sync)]) -> WResult<u64> {
    c.execute(sql, params).await.map_err(|e| {
        if e.as_db_error().is_some() {
            WriteError::Runtime
        } else {
            WriteError::Infra(e.to_string())
        }
    })
}

/// UPDATE that must affect exactly one row (mirrors Hibernate's

async fn exec_one(c: &(impl tokio_postgres::GenericClient + Sync), sql: &str, params: &[&(dyn ToSql + Sync)]) -> WResult<()> {
    let n = exec(c, sql, params).await?;
    if n != 1 {
        return Err(WriteError::Runtime);
    }
    Ok(())

pub async fn update_datasource(
    c: &(impl tokio_postgres::GenericClient + Sync),
    d: &DataSource,
    m: &Mutation,
    conflicts: &Conflicts,
) -> WResult<()> {
    let id = d.id.ok_or(WriteError::Runtime)?;
    let now = db::now();
    // handle the cascaded tileGrid first (its row must exist for the FK)
    let tilegrid_id = if m.refs.contains("tileGrid") {
        write_tilegrid_ref(c, &d.tile_grid, conflicts).await?
    } else {
        d.tile_grid.as_ref().and_then(|g| g.id)
    };
    exec(
        c,
        "UPDATE layerdatasources SET format=$2, name=$3, type=$4, url=$5, modified=$6 WHERE id=$1",
        &[&id, &d.format, &d.name, &d.ds_type, &d.url, &now],
    )
    .await?;
    match d.kind {
        DsKind::ImageWms | DsKind::TileWms => {
            exec(
                c,
                "UPDATE imagewmslayerdatasources SET customrequestpath=$2, height=$3, layernames=$4, layerstyles=$5, requestablebypath=$6, version=$7, width=$8 WHERE id=$1",
                &[
                    &id,
                    &d.custom_request_path,
                    &d.height,
                    &d.layer_names,
                    &d.layer_styles,
                    &d.requestable_by_path,
                    &d.version,
                    &d.width,
                ],
            )
            .await?;
            if d.kind == DsKind::TileWms {
                exec(
                    c,
                    "UPDATE tilewmslayerdatasources SET request_with_tiled=$2, tilegrid_id=$3 WHERE id=$1",
                    &[&id, &d.request_with_tiled, &tilegrid_id],
                )
                .await?;
            }
        }
        DsKind::Wfs => {
            exec(
                c,
                "UPDATE wfslayerdatasources SET typename=$2, typenames=$3, version=$4 WHERE id=$1",
                &[&id, &d.type_name, &d.type_names, &d.version],
            )
            .await?;
        }
        DsKind::Wmts => {
            exec(
                c,
                "UPDATE wmtslayerdatasources SET capabilitiesurl=$2, matrixset=$3, projection=$4, requestencoding=$5, wmtslayer=$6, wmtsstyle=$7, tilegrid_id=$8 WHERE id=$1",
                &[
                    &id,
                    &d.capabilities_url,
                    &d.matrix_set,
                    &d.projection,
                    &d.request_encoding,
                    &d.wmts_layer,
                    &d.wmts_style,
                    &tilegrid_id,
                ],
            )
            .await?;
            if m.collections.contains("urls") {
                write_wmts_urls(c, d).await?;
            }
        }
        DsKind::Xyz => {
            let extent_id = if m.refs.contains("extent") {
                match &d.extent {
                    None => None,
                    Some(e) => {
                        // @OneToOne without cascade: only the FK is written; a
                        // transient extent is a TransientObjectException.
                        if e.id.is_none() {
                            return Err(WriteError::Runtime);
                        }
                        e.id
                    }
                }
            } else {
                d.extent.as_ref().and_then(|e| e.id)
            };
            let (cx, cy) = match d.center {
                Some(p) => (Some(p.x), Some(p.y)),
                None => (None, None),
            };
            exec(
                c,
                "UPDATE xyzlayerdatasources SET center_x=$2, center_y=$3, tilesize=$4, extent_id=$5 WHERE id=$1",
                &[&id, &cx, &cy, &d.tile_size, &extent_id],
            )
            .await?;
            if m.collections.contains("resolutions") {
                write_xyz_resolutions(c, d).await?;
            }
        }
        DsKind::Base => {}
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub async fn delete_entity(
    c: &(impl tokio_postgres::GenericClient + Sync),
    rt: ResourceType,
    kind: Option<DsKind>,
    id: i32,
) -> WResult<()> {
    match rt {
        ResourceType::Users => {
            exec(c, "DELETE FROM users_roles WHERE user_id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
            exec(c, "DELETE FROM user_usergroup WHERE user_id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
            delete_permissions(c, id).await?;
            exec(c, "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
            exec(c, "DELETE FROM persons WHERE id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
        }
        ResourceType::Groups => {
            exec(c, "DELETE FROM user_usergroup WHERE usergroup_id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
            exec(c, "DELETE FROM usergroups_roles WHERE usergroup_id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
            delete_permissions(c, id).await?;
            exec(c, "DELETE FROM usergroups WHERE id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
        }
        ResourceType::Roles => {
            // Role owns no join tables: users_roles is owned by User.roles and
            // usergroups_roles by UserGroup.roles, so references from them lead
            // to a foreign key violation, exactly like in the original.
            delete_permissions(c, id).await?;
            exec(c, "DELETE FROM roles WHERE id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
        }
        ResourceType::Layers => {
            // LayerService.delete removes the layer from all maps first
            exec(c, "DELETE FROM maps_layers WHERE layer_id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
            delete_permissions(c, id).await?;
            exec(c, "DELETE FROM layers WHERE id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
        }
        ResourceType::DataSources => {
            match kind {
                Some(DsKind::TileWms) => {
                    exec(c, "DELETE FROM tilewmslayerdatasources WHERE id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
                    exec(c, "DELETE FROM imagewmslayerdatasources WHERE id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
                }
                Some(DsKind::ImageWms) => {
                    exec(c, "DELETE FROM imagewmslayerdatasources WHERE id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
                }
                Some(DsKind::Wfs) => {
                    exec(c, "DELETE FROM wfslayerdatasources WHERE id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
                }
                Some(DsKind::Wmts) => {
                    exec(c, "DELETE FROM wmtslayerdatasources_urls WHERE wmtslayerdatasources_id = $1", &[&id])
                        .await?;
                    exec(c, "DELETE FROM wmtslayerdatasources WHERE id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
                }
                Some(DsKind::Xyz) => {
                    exec(c, "DELETE FROM xyzlayerdatasrc_resolution WHERE xyzlayerdatasrc_id = $1", &[&id])
                        .await?;
                    exec(c, "DELETE FROM xyzlayerdatasources WHERE id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
                }
                _ => {}
            }
            delete_permissions(c, id).await?;
            exec(c, "DELETE FROM layerdatasources WHERE id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
        }
        ResourceType::Appearances => {
            exec(c, "DELETE FROM layerappearances_properties WHERE appearance_id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
            delete_permissions(c, id).await?;
            exec(c, "DELETE FROM layerappearances WHERE id = $1", &[&id]).await?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
